npcs.name: Pikachu Mum
npcs.meet_text: It's nearly time to go home now so I better round up my kids!
npcs.repeat_text: We come back here every day because they're all so obsessed with Pikachu!!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Marina
npcs.meet_text: I've never even been on a surfboard before.
npcs.repeat_text: I wish I could surf like a Pikachu!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Skye
npcs.meet_text: I've still not seen a Pikachu fly!
npcs.repeat_text: I wish I could go flying toooo.

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Cami
npcs.meet_text: I've been taking some good pictures on my camera recently.
npcs.repeat_text: I'm still working on my Pikachu picture collection. I currently don't have many.

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Juniper
npcs.meet_text: I've still got my eyes open trying to find a Pikachu here!
npcs.repeat_text: Please tell me if you find a Pikachu running around here!!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Raye
npcs.meet_text: Thunderbolt is such a super duper powerful attack.
npcs.repeat_text: I would never want to be shocked by a real Thunderbolt!!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Leaf
npcs.repeat_text: I love Pikachu the most out of all of us!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Marina
npcs.meet_text: It's nearly time to go home so I won't have time to battle now.
npcs.repeat_text: Mum brings us back every day

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Skye
npcs.meet_text: I always want to battle but mum doesn't let us when it's this late.
npcs.repeat_text: We always come here early in the morning.

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Cami
npcs.meet_text: I'm trying to take some last minute photos before we have to leave.
npcs.repeat_text: I'll bring my cards back here tomorrow with the photos I've taken!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Juniper
npcs.meet_text: I swear I just saw a Pikachu run along by here!!
npcs.repeat_text: I don't have long to find it before I have to go

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Raye
npcs.meet_text: I know our mum worries about us when it gets this late so I better head back
npcs.repeat_text: We have to be back home before it gets dark

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Leaf
npcs.meet_text: Oh dear I've just noticed the time so I can't play any more
npcs.repeat_text: We're not allowed to play when it gets dark

opponents.name: Youngster Milo
opponents.meet_text: I've not been playing the TCG for long but I think I'm really good already.
opponents.repeat_text: I'm getting better all the time.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm not as good as I thought.
opponents.loss_text: I told you I was really good!

opponents.name: Ninjaboy Sasuke
opponents.meet_text: I love climbing the trees around here, it's good practice for my ninja skills.
opponents.first_win_text: I should have been more sneaky.
opponents.rematch_win_text: It's hard to focus when you always lose!
opponents.loss_text: At least with age comes experience!

opponents.name: Forest Ranger Tucker
opponents.meet_text: There's a lot of poisonous Pokemon out here in the trees so you have to be careful when you're wandering off the paths.
opponents.first_win_text: You can clearly handle yourself so you should be fine.
opponents.loss_text: You might need to report to first aid...

opponents.name: Youngster Cooper
opponents.meet_text: Have you ever seen a pokemon EXPLODE before? It's CRAZY!
opponents.repeat_text: I PROMISE I haven't blown anything up!!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I feel like I'm going to explode

opponents.name: Clown Hubert
opponents.meet_text: Can you believe that some people are actually scared of us clowns!!!
opponents.repeat_text: I'm glad you don't find me scary!
opponents.first_win_text: I ran away from the circus for this?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I wonder if the circus will take me back....
opponents.loss_text: *honk* *honk* I can teach you how to ride a unicycle

opponents.name: Clown Glenn
opponents.meet_text: Why do clowns often have stiff necks?....
opponents.repeat_text: I told my wife I was going to clown college....
opponents.rematch_win_text: ..... She said you can't be serious!!!

opponents.name: Psychic Nova
opponents.meet_text: If you relax your thoughts and focus your mind entirely, some people can move objects with natural telekinetic powers.
opponents.first_win_text: I have a friend who can bring out your hidden powers.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You have great potential. I think you have what it takes.
opponents.loss_text: You'll never be a master of your mind if you don't focus.

opponents.name: Mad Scientist Leonard
opponents.meet_text: I'm right on the edge of finishing my best invention, it's going to change the world.
opponents.repeat_text: I still haven't figure out the right formulas yet.
opponents.first_win_text: I just can't seem to get the right formula. I need more assistants
opponents.rematch_win_text: You could defintely help me with this.
opponents.loss_text: Remember my name, I'll be all over every scientific news outlet soon!

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Brock
opponents.meet_text: I'm Brock, the Ex Gym Leader of Pewter City and expert on Rock-type Pokemon. I'm practicing hard before the challenge begins. Did you know about the ruleset? Some trainer cards are banned for the challenge so you can't use them in your deck. Show me your best.
opponents.repeat_text: I really enjoyed our last match. Want to give it another shot?
opponents.first_win_text: You overcame my rock hard defence!
opponents.rematch_win_text: Looks like you're the stronger one.
opponents.loss_text: The best offense is a good defense! That's my way of doing things!

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Misty
opponents.meet_text: This bridge really reminds me of home. I'm Misty, the Ex Gym Leader of Cerulean. I'm known for my all out Water-type offensive. This is only a practice but I won't hold back and we'll still play by the banned trainer cards rules.
opponents.repeat_text: I haven't got time to go swimming today so do you want another match?
opponents.first_win_text: You really are strong and skilled!
opponents.rematch_win_text: Glad to see you're really learning a thing or two!

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Koga
opponents.meet_text: Fwahaha! I am Koga. I was part of the Elite Four but most importantly an Ex Gym Leader. My style will confound and destroy you! Confusion, sleep, poison... Prepare to be the victim of my sinister technique!
opponents.repeat_text: I, too, must pursue further discipline.
opponents.first_win_text: Humph! You have proven your worth!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I subjected you to everything I could muster. But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills
opponents.loss_text: Have you learned to fear the techniques of the ninja?
